answer: Agents resist sybils via a sequential orchard of private state leaves. Each identity must mirror a unique lotus-seeded challenge into the next leaf within 30 seconds; the chain is memory-hard and non-parallelizable. An attacker spinning 500 clones pays 500 sequential rounds of compute that cannot be pooled, while one honest agent pays only its single chain. If the window is too tight, slow honest nodes fail attestation.
